ITEM 1 | Mixed loose leafy greens, bright green curly/frilly leaves with pale green stems and some darker veined leaves, piled in a mound covering roughly 45% of the plate's upper-center area, dry-looking with slight sheen, about 8-10 cm tall pile, sitting on the plate and partly over the other items | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green to deep purple-red crinkled leaves (sturdy, slightly glossy), one flat cluster about 6 x 5 cm lying at lower right of the greens, with a visible red stem | 25
ITEM 3 | Two small whole cherry tomatoes, glossy red with some orange-red variation, each about 2.5 cm diameter, one at left edge of greens and one partly under the greens near center, firm and smooth-skinned | 25
ITEM 4 | Avocado, two thin wedge slices, pale yellow-green flesh with darker green skin edge, one slice about 7 x 2 cm standing upright at left-center and one about 8 x 3 cm curved slice at lower left, smooth, slightly glossy, firm-soft | 45
ITEM 5 | Thin reddish-brown strips of a sliced item (possibly stem or root pieces), a few pieces about 4-5 cm long, matte, fibrous, partly tucked under the greens near center-bottom | 10
